notes:
Snapshot of account and POC notes:
- Vertical: user-level real-time personalization for home feed + ad ranking; tight p95 latency needs for user-facing decisions.
- Business ask: match or beat current self-hosted 2x cost with equal or better latencies. Cost sensitivity = high (target ARR cost reduction 2-3x).
- Performance targets (customer-provided): p95 latency < 60ms for 64-token responses at median concurrency; sustained throughput target 300-500 RPS for reranking pipeline, peak bursts to 2k RPS.
- Security: must run in VPC with SAML SSO, audit logs shipped to their SIEM, KMS-integrated key management, and EU data residency for EU traffic. SOC2 required.
- Model preferences: open-weight Llama-derivative and a trimmed distilled model for latency-critical routes; willing to test 4-bit and 8-bit quantized variants. Want automatic fallback to slightly larger model when quality drop detected.
- Optimize interest: batching policies (adaptive batching vs fixed), KV/prefix caching to exploit repeated context (expect ~30% prefix reuse in-session), and quantization profiles (int8 -> int4 tradeoffs).
- Benchmarks so far: 2026-03-09 perf sweep attached (drive link). 4-bit quantization saved ~28% token-cost but increased p99 by +35ms on long-tail prompts. Dynamic batching improved throughput but added tail latency spikes; need better kernel selection and cache priming.
- SE notes: proposed Dedicated GPU pool with small burstable capacity + Redwood Optimize tuning. Recommend controlled canary with A/B on latency-sensitive routes.
- Quote from CTO on 2026-02-11 call: "We can't accept anything that adds jitter to the feed ranking; predictable 50-70ms p95 is non-negotiable."
- Typical CRM shorthand: POC active, running perf runs, security review started, pricing negotiation mid-stage.
- Next milestones: 2026-03-20 procurement sync, complete pen-test window by 2026-03-25, final perf report 2026-03-22.
